news.headline: What Is Caterpillar (CAT) Signaling With Its Biggest Underground Mining Machine Yet?
news.summary: Caterpillar (NYSE:CAT) has introduced the CAT R3200 XE LHD, its largest underground diesel-electric mining machine to date. The new loader combines diesel-electric power with advanced autonomous and semi-autonomous capabilities for underground mining operations. Caterpillar is positioning the R3200 XE LHD to improve throughput and fuel efficiency for mining customers using digital control systems.
